data.label: Full Chess Game
data.description: Full-featured chess: complete legal move generation, check/checkmate detection, minimax AI opponent, and saved games.
data.appGoal: A full-featured chess game where users play against a minimax AI opponent or another player, with complete legal move generation, check/checkmate/stalemate detection, and save/load of games
data.appPurpose: Users play chess on a board UI with legal-move highlighting, an AI opponent with difficulty levels, undo, and save/load games

data.label: Board State
data.description: 8x8 board representation with piece placement, side-to-move tracking, move history, castling/en-passant rights, and FEN import/export. Foundational module that every other file imports.

data.label: Move Rules
data.description: Legal move generation for all six piece types including castling, en passant, and promotion, plus pinned-piece filtering and check/checkmate/stalemate detection.

data.label: Chess Input
data.description: Parses player input — click square-to-square moves and algebraic notation (SAN) — validates legality against the rules engine, and applies moves with undo/redo support.

data.label: AI Engine
data.description: Minimax search with alpha-beta pruning, piece-square evaluation tables, and selectable difficulty levels (Easy/Medium/Hard). Plays either color.

data.label: Game Storage
data.description: Save/load in-progress games and export/import games in PGN format, with full move history and game metadata.

data.label: Board Renderer
data.description: Renders the chess board and pieces, highlights legal moves on click, animates captures, and shows the captured-piece tray, check indicator, and game-over banner.

data.label: GUI Controls
data.description: GUI control layer: New Game, Undo, Flip Board, difficulty selector, and Save/Load buttons wired to the game actions.
